select from preg_diet_record d where d.actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} and d.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_diet_record ( meal_type, occurred_at, record_date, content, note, extra_text, actor_user_id, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{mealType}, #{occurredAt}, #{recordDate}, #{content}, #{note}, #{extraText}, #{actorUserId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_diet_record set meal_type = #{mealType}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, record_date = #{recordDate}, content = #{content}, note = #{note}, extra_text = #{extraText}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_diet_record set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from preg_diet_record d where d.record_date = #{date} and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.occurred_at asc, d.id asc
